app.name: Urban Ladder
app.developer: Urban Ladder Home Decor Solutions Private Limited
app.description: India's leading furniture and home decor shopping app offering sofas, beds, dining sets, lighting, and more with in-store and online shopping features.

verdict.one_liner: Urban Ladder records your audio and video calls, may transfer your data in a corporate sale, and tracks your browsing patterns, but does not use personal information to target advertisements.
verdict.summary: Urban Ladder's privacy policy reveals that the app records audio and video calls with customers for quality and training purposes, and these recordings may be shared with third parties when required by law. Your data may be transferred to a new owner if Urban Ladder is sold or reorganized. The app tracks your IP address, browser type, and the websites you visit before and after using the platform. On the positive side, Urban Ladder explicitly states it does not use personal information to target ads, provides a grievance officer, and allows opt-out of marketing communications.
verdict.recommendation_reason: If you are concerned about audio and video call recordings being stored and potentially shared, and the possibility of your data being transferred in a corporate sale, consider the trade-off before installing.

red.title: Records audio and video calls
red.plain_english: Urban Ladder records your video calls and audio calls with them for product demonstrations, quality improvement, and follow-up queries. These recordings may be shared with third parties when required by law.

red.title: Data may be transferred in corporate sale
red.plain_english: If Urban Ladder is sold, reorganized, or transfers its assets, your personal information may be disclosed or transferred to the new owner.

red.title: Shares data with third-party service providers
red.plain_english: Urban Ladder shares your information with third-party service providers including payment gateways, and may share telephone records and audio/video recordings with third parties when required by law.

red.title: Tracks your browsing before and after visiting
red.plain_english: Urban Ladder automatically collects the URL of the site you came from and the site you visit after leaving their platform, along with your IP address, operating system, browser type, and internet service provider.

green.title: Does not use personal info to target ads
green.plain_english: Urban Ladder explicitly states that it does not use your personal information to target advertisements to you.

green.title: Has a dedicated grievance officer
green.plain_english: Urban Ladder has appointed a Grievance Officer (Sanjay Kawle) with a dedicated email address (grievanceofficer@urbanladder.com) for handling privacy complaints.

green.title: Can opt out of marketing communications
green.plain_english: You can opt out of receiving promotional emails by clicking the unsubscribe link or contacting Urban Ladder directly.

green.title: Not directed at children
green.plain_english: Urban Ladder states its platform is not directed towards minors under 18, and will delete information if discovered to have been collected from a child.

categories.label: Camera & Microphone
categories.plain_english: Urban Ladder records your video calls and audio calls for product demonstrations, improving service quality, and assisting with follow-up queries.
categories.detail: The privacy policy explicitly states that Urban Ladder may record video calls and audio calls carried out with you for the purpose of providing visual demonstrations of products, improving quality of service, and assisting with follow-up queries.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may also record video calls, audio calls carried out with you ('Audio, Video Recordings'), for the purpose of providing visual demonstration of our products, improving quality of service and assisting with any follow-up queries
concerns: Audio and video calls are recorded
Recordings may be shared with third parties when required by law

categories.label: Location & GPS
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not explicitly mention GPS location tracking, though your IP address is collected automatically.
categories.detail: No explicit mention of GPS or precise location access. IP address is collected for trend analysis.
concerns: Policy is silent on GPS location access

categories.label: Contacts & Phonebook
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention whether the app accesses your contacts or phonebook.
categories.detail: No explicit mention of contacts or phonebook access in the privacy policy.
concerns: Policy is silent on contacts access

categories.label: Storage & File Access
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy does not mention whether the app accesses files or storage on your device.
categories.detail: No explicit mention of storage or file access permissions in the privacy policy.
concerns: Policy is silent on storage access

categories.label: Data Sharing with 3rd Parties
categories.plain_english: Urban Ladder shares your data with third-party service providers like payment gateways, may transfer it to a new owner in a corporate sale, and may share audio/video recordings with third parties when required by law.
categories.detail: Data is shared with trusted third-party service providers for facilitating services. Information may be disclosed or transferred to any third party as part of reorganization or sale of assets. Telephone records and audio/video recordings may be shared with third parties when required by law.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may from time to time be required to disclose the Information collected from you to our trusted third-party service providers who assist us in order to facilitate the provision of services... We may also disclose or transfer your Information to any third party as a part of reorganization or a sale of the assets, division or transfer of a part or whole of us... We may share such telephone records or any other Audio, Video Recordings with third parties when required by law or when required to provide or facilitate the User with the services.
concerns: Data shared with third-party service providers
All data may be transferred in merger/sale
Audio/video recordings shared with third parties when required by law

categories.label: Account & Identity Data
categories.plain_english: Urban Ladder collects your name, password, mailing address, phone number, email address, gender, and date of birth when you create an account or interact with the platform.
categories.detail: Standard account information collected for order processing, delivery, and customer service. Passwords are stored as sensitive personal data.
categories.policy_excerpt: We may collect a variety of information from you, including your name, password, mailing address, phone number, email address, IP address, contact preferences... Personal Information shall include but is not limited to your full name, personal contact numbers, residential address, email address, gender or date of birth.
concerns: Password collected and stored
Gender and date of birth collected

categories.label: Behavioural & Ad Tracking
categories.plain_english: Urban Ladder uses cookies and collects your browsing patterns, but explicitly states it does not use your personal information to target advertisements to you.
categories.detail: Temporary cookies are used to store data. Aggregate findings (not specific data) may be shared with advertisers, sponsors, and partners. Third parties may place cookies on your browser for ads. However, Urban Ladder explicitly states it does not use personal information to target advertisements.
categories.policy_excerpt: We do not use Personal Information to target advertisements to you... We may allow other companies or entities to serve advertisements to you... In the course of serving advertisements or optimizing the services to its Users, we may allow authorised third parties to place or recognize a unique cookie on the User's browser.
concerns: Third-party cookies for advertisements
Aggregate data shared with advertisers

categories.label: Children's Data Handling
categories.plain_english: Urban Ladder states its platform is not directed towards minors under 18, and will take steps to delete information if discovered to have been collected from a child.
categories.detail: Explicit statement that the platform is not directed towards minors and that they do not knowingly collect personal information from users under 18.
categories.policy_excerpt: Urban Ladder Platform is not directed towards minors. We do not knowingly collect Personal Information from any User who is under 18 (Eighteen) years. If we are made aware that we have collected the Personal Information of a person below the age of 18 (Eighteen) years, we will take steps to delete the information within a reasonable time frame.

categories.label: Network & Internet Activity
categories.plain_english: Urban Ladder collects the URL of the site you came from, the site you visit after leaving, your IP address, operating system, browser type, email patterns, and internet service provider.
categories.detail: Automatic collection of referrer URL, exit URL, IP address, OS, browser type, email patterns, and ISP name for trend analysis. Aggregate findings may be shared with advertisers and partners.
categories.policy_excerpt: when you visit, access or browse the Urban Ladder Platform, we automatically receive the uniform resource locator of the site from which such you visit... details of the website you visit on leaving the Urban Ladder Platform, the internet protocol ('IP') address of each User's computer operating system, type of web browser the User is using, email patterns, and the name of the User's internet service provider.
concerns: Referrer and exit URLs tracked
Email patterns collected
Aggregate data shared with advertisers

categories.label: Device Info & Fingerprinting
categories.plain_english: Urban Ladder collects your IP address, operating system type, browser type, and internet service provider name.
categories.detail: Device-level information collected automatically for trend analysis and service improvement.
categories.policy_excerpt: the internet protocol ('IP') address of each User's computer operating system, type of web browser the User is using, email patterns, and the name of the User's internet service provider
concerns: IP address collected
OS and browser type collected

categories.label: Health & Biometric Data
categories.plain_english: The privacy policy lists physical, physiological and mental health condition as a category of sensitive personal data, but does not explicitly state that such data is collected.
categories.detail: Health condition is listed as a category of sensitive personal data under Indian law, but there is no explicit statement that Urban Ladder actively collects this information.
categories.policy_excerpt: Physical, physiological and mental health condition
concerns: Policy lists health as sensitive data category but does not confirm collection

categories.label: Financial & Payment Data
categories.plain_english: Urban Ladder collects your financial information including credit/debit card numbers and bank account details, but these are processed by third-party payment gateways under encryption. Urban Ladder does not handle the verification directly.
categories.detail: Financial information is collected but processed through secure third-party payment gateways under encryption. Urban Ladder explicitly states it has no role in the verification process and bears no liability for payment gateway actions.
categories.policy_excerpt: Financial information including, but not restricted to, your credit/debit card number or your bank account details or other payment instrument details... The Financial Information collected from you is transacted through secure digital platforms of approved payment gateways which are under encryption... The verification of the Financial Information shall be accomplished only by you through a process of authentication in which we shall have no role to play
concerns: Financial information collected
Third-party payment gateways handle transactions

categories.label: Data Deletion & User Rights
categories.plain_english: You can request access, amendment, alteration, or deletion of your information by contacting Urban Ladder at hello@urbanladder.com or grievanceofficer@urbanladder.com.
categories.detail: Users can exercise data rights by contacting Urban Ladder via email. No self-service portal is explicitly mentioned.
categories.policy_excerpt: You may access, amend, alter or require deletion of your Information partially or fully by contacting us at hello@urbanladder.com... If you wish to remove your contact information from all our mailing lists and newsletters, you can click on the 'unsubscribe' link or follow the instructions in each e-mail message. Alternatively, you can contact us at grievanceofficer@urbanladder.com.
concerns: No self-service deletion portal
Requires email request

categories.label: Policy Change Notification
categories.plain_english: Urban Ladder reserves the right to amend the privacy policy at any time and encourages users to review it periodically, but does not explicitly promise to notify you of material changes.
categories.detail: The policy states it may be amended at any time and will be updated on the platform. Users are encouraged to review it periodically. No explicit notification mechanism or consent requirement for material changes.
categories.policy_excerpt: We reserve the right to amend this Privacy Policy at any time. The Privacy Policy, as and when modified, shall be updated on the Urban Ladder Platform. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy whenever you visit our Urban Ladder Platform
concerns: No explicit notification of material changes
No consent required for policy changes
